name: Particle in a Box (Infinite Potential Well)
methods: Solve second-order ODE to find sinusoidal eigenfunctions
Compute expectation values and position-momentum uncertainties
problem_types: Quantum well confinement in semiconductor nanostructures
Optical absorption in conjugated polyenes (particle in a box model)
Calculation of ground-state energy, expectation values <x> and <p^2>
pitfalls: Allowing n = 0 (which results in a trivial zero wavefunction, violating normalization)
Assuming non-zero probability at the infinite potential boundaries
Forgetting normalization factor sqrt(2/L) in inner products
